extraction.notes: Whole report screened: Chapter 2 (cluster 2 summary page 77 and chapter section pages 79-80) extracted in full; every other section searched for passages that materially concern the technology theme, using the table of contents and keyword searches, with surrounding text read in context. Period covered taken from footnote 1 of the report (June 2022 to June 2023); the register leaves it blank. The report summary (pages 4-8) repeats wording from the chapter sections; repeated sentences were extracted once, from the chapter section. Chapter 2 contains no technology element (no reference to EESSI or other electronic systems). Figures for online public services differ within the report (238 on page 81, 392 on page 91, 230 on page 122) and household internet access differs between page 66 (83.6%) and the annex (83.7).
